name: midPoint
description: Identity governance and administration platform for provisioning, reconciling, and auditing accounts across systems.

envVars.description: Password for the midPoint Postgres database user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      MP_SET_midpoint_repository_jdbcUrl: "jdbc:postgresql://{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/midpoint"
      MP_SET_midpoint_repository_jdbcUsername: midpoint
      MP_SET_midpoint_repository_jdbcPassword: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/opt/midpoint/var
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: midpoint
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: midpoint
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
